title: Fades
name: Fades
description: Stop fading clips one by one. Select your tracks and Fades puts the right fade on every clip at once: crossfades where clips touch, fade-ins and fade-outs on free edges. New: Strip silence removes what does not sound and fades every new cut in the same click, with a preview of what goes. Presets for toms, vocals and dialog, one-click undo, 7 languages.
